headline: Retail 'Borrow to Invest' Surges… Securities Firms Go All-In on Short-Term Funding via CP and Short-Term Bonds
summary: Securities firms' CP and short-term bond issuance reached 72.4 trillion won this year, up 170% from a year earlier. Issuance has decreased during the recent market correction.
why: Brokers' short-term funding through commercial paper and bonds is a key source of margin lending for retail investors, which affects market liquidity and risk.
